scope: All 80 registered page declarations, every retained business section/dimension, every existing global work item and shared/native/deployment lane

sourceFreshness.meaning: Current bytes AND admitted source path set must match; changed evidence is historical, not a current pass.

canonicalMasterEvidence.meaning: Matching current files, internally valid source digest, completed unchanged master and every required group are needed; inventory regeneration alone is not execution.

globalRequirements.acceptance: Every required artifact and linked case matches the final admitted source; stale evidence remains historical.
A false condition causes the expected AssertionError/exit 1; real positive suites and upload-integrity cleanup pass.
Actual preparation, both verifications and cold startup pass with unchanged admitted inputs; no fixture bypass or manifest rewriting.
All exact required checks and every section dimension pass, with zero invalid links or unresolved mappings.
All requested actual coverage counters reach 100% with verified provenance; no exclusions or threshold relaxation.
All four accessibility criteria pass per page/section with current evidence; no unreviewed manual item becomes green.
Target origin, release identity, cookies/headers and required public/provider paths are verified on the actual deployment.
Actual target schema and compatible writer behavior are verified after safe migration; restored backup and rollback limits are documented.
Each enabled provider's actual target journey and failure lifecycle has source-bound receipt/cleanup; test acceptance is not production delivery.
Actual isolated target topology meets explicit request/error/p95 and recovery budgets; projections remain labeled projections.
Each supported client builds, installs, starts securely and passes actual target journeys; no product sandbox disable or packaged provider/database secrets.
Original-source Linux plugin builds and actual supported DAW hosting pass; Windows binary metadata is not Linux source.
Every applicable AI criterion and actual page consumer passes without obsolete checkpoint requirements, fake generated output or private-data learning.
Period-specific owned data is verified or the product clearly and correctly exposes unavailable history without claiming a completed historical feature.
